title: RIALC - Repertorio informatizzato dell'antica letteratura catalana
notes: RIALC (built 1999-2003 at Naples Federico II, in collaboration with the Universities of Barcelona, UAB and Girona) is the standard digital library of medieval Catalan poetry: ~216 authors and ~1,600 13th-15th c. poems transcribed from critical editions (HTML, not TEI). The texts include Joan de Masdovelles (~1460, 9 poems) and Joan Berenguer de Masdovelles (~1460, 168 poems); they are author pages of this repertory. No explicit licence; site is live but the project is no longer actively extended. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II (dir. Costanzo Di Girolamo, with Lola Badia)
